task: Extend the codemie-ui agent workspace browser preview to render Markdown (with front matter as a code block), pretty-print JSON, show more text formats, and add an expanded view that Esc collapses without closing the browser.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest patterns are MarkdownEditor fullscreenPreview and ExpandableTextarea (nested Popup) for expand, and the chat Markdown component for rendering, which already has the sanitize path. Two things are not covered: the outer Popup's PrimeReact closeOnEscape would close and reset the whole browser, so Esc has to collapse only the expanded view, and the Popup test mock hides that. The AC also lists edge cases (front matter split, invalid JSON fallback, extension routing) that no existing helper test template covers, so Technical Risk is bumped from S to M.

A single UI component (AgentWorkspaceBrowserPopup) plus an optional small helper module for routing, front matter and JSON formatting. It reuses the existing Markdown component and expand/collapse icons, and no store, API or backend change is needed.

About 2 modified files (the popup and ChatHeaderBrowseFilesButton.test) and 1-2 new ones (a helper and its __tests__ file), all in the ChatHeader directory. The calibration example s/epmcdme-10102 (total 11) matches the band.
